identificationModule.briefTitle: Brief Title: Aerobic Training on Cerebrovascular Function, Cognition and Gait in Parkinson's Disease
identificationModule.officialTitle: Effects of Aerobic Training on Cerebrovascular Function, Cognitive Performance and Gait Parameters in Patients With Parkinson's Disease: A Randomized Controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This randomized controlled trial will investigate the effects of a 12-week supervised aerobic training program on cerebrovascular function, peripheral vascular health, cardiovascular autonomic modulation, cognition, non-motor symptoms, sleep, mood, gait biomechanics, quality of life, and body composition in patients with Parkinson's disease (Hoehn \& Yahr stages 1-3). Participants will be randomly allocated to aerobic training or usual care.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is a parallel-group randomized controlled trial Participants (n=40) diagnosed with Parkinson's disease, stages 1-3 on Hoehn \& Yahr scale, will be randomly allocated (1:1 block randomization) to:

* Aerobic Training Group;
* Control Group (usual care)

The intervention will last 12 weeks, 3 sessions/week Pre and post-intervention assessments will include:

* Cerebrovascular function: neurovascular coupling, cerebrovascular reactivity (breath-holding index), dynamic cerebral autoregulation (transfer function analysis), and acute cerebral blood flow response to exercise (transcranial Doppler; vertebral artery flow during silent reading).
* Peripheral vascular and cardiovascular function: brachial artery flow-mediated dilation, carotid intima-media thickness, resting blood pressure, resting heart rate, cardiorespiratory fitness (VO₂peak), heart rate variability (time and frequency domains), and baroreflex sensitivity.
* Cognitive performance: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), Trail Making Test A and B, and Stroop Color-Word Test.
* Gait biomechanics: spatiotemporal parameters, 3D kinematics (Vicon system), and kinetics (force platform).
* Clinical and non-motor symptoms: UPDRS, Non-Motor Symptoms Scale (NMSS), sleep quality (PDSS), anxiety (PAS), depressive symptoms (GDS-15), apathy (Apathy Inventory), fatigue (Parkinson Fatigue Scale), pain (Numeric Rating Scale), and quality of life (PDQ-8).
* Body composition: quadriceps muscle thickness and subcutaneous adipose tissue thickness assessed by ultrasound.

All experimental sessions will be performed in the "on" medication state

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: Outcomes assessor will be blinded for the group of the subjects

armGroups.label: Aerobic Training
armGroups.description: Participants will perform supervised aerobic training on a cycle ergometer, 3 times per week for 12 weeks, 40 minutes per session, at perceived exertion 12-13 on Borg scale.

armGroups.label: Usual Care
armGroups.description: Participants will maintain their usual clinical care and daily activities without structured exercise intervention.

primaryOutcomes.description: Breath-holding index (dimensionless) assessed by transcranial Doppler

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Neurovascular Coupling at 12 Weeks.
primaryOutcomes.description: Measured by relative (%) changes in middle cerebral artery blood flow velocity during standardized cognitive tasks (Stroop Color-Word Test, Trail Making Test A and B, and silent reading protocol) using transcranial Doppler ultrasound.
Transfer function gain and phase (0.02-0.4 Hz frequency bands).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Acute Cerebral Blood Flow Response to Exercise
primaryOutcomes.description: Change in middle cerebral artery velocity during 6-minute aerobic bout.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Brachial Artery Endothelial Function
secondaryOutcomes.description: Flow-mediated dilation (FMD, %) of the brachial artery assessed by high-resolution vascular ultrasound according to current guidelines.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Brachial Artery Baseline Diameter
secondaryOutcomes.description: Resting brachial artery diameter (mm) measured by vascular ultrasound
Common carotid artery intima-media thickness (mm) assessed by B-mode ultrasound.
Systolic and diastolic blood pressure (mmHg).
Heart rate (beats per minute).
SDNN derived from beat-to-beat recordings at rest.
Low-frequency power (ms²) derived from spectral analysis.
Assessed with Montreal Cognitive Assessment that provides a score

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Executive Function and Attention
secondaryOutcomes.description: Assessed with Trail Making Test Part A and Part B (time to completion, seconds).
Assessed with Non-Motor Symptoms Scale that provides a score. Higher scores indicate greater symptom burden.
Assessed with the Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale (UPDRS total score).
Assessed with the Parkinson Anxiety Scale total score (0-48). Higher scores indicate greater anxiety severity.
Assessed with Geriatric Depression Scale total score (0-15). Higher scores indicate greater depressive symptom severity.
Assessed with Apathy Inventory total score (0-12). Higher scores indicate greater apathy.
Parkinson Fatigue Scale total score (range: 16-80). Higher scores indicate greater fatigue severity.
Assessed with Parkinson's Disease Sleep Scale total score (0-150). Lower scores indicate worse sleep quality.
Assessed using a Numeric Rating Scale (0-10). Higher values indicate higher pain
Assessed with Parkinson's Disease Questionnaire-8 (PDQ-8 total score).
Gait speed (meters/second) assessed during overground walking using motion capture analysis.
Joint angles (degrees) of hip, knee, and ankle during walking assessed by 3D motion capture.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Joint Moments During Walking
secondaryOutcomes.description: Joint moments (Nm/kg) of the hip, knee, and ankle during walking assessed using force platform analysis.
Quadriceps muscle thickness (mm) assessed by B-mode ultrasound at standardized anatomical landmarks.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Subcutaneous Adipose Tissue Thickness
secondaryOutcomes.description: Subcutaneous fat thickness (mm) assessed by B-mode ultrasound at standardized anatomical landmarks.
RMSSD (ms) derived from beat-to-beat recordings at rest.
High-frequency power (ms²)derived from spectral analysis

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Low Frequency/High Frequency ratio
secondaryOutcomes.description: Low-frequency/high-frequency ratio derived from spectral analysis
Cadence (steps/minute) assessed during overground walking using motion capture analysis.
Stride length (meters) assessed during overground walking using motion capture analysis.
Double support time (% of gait cycle) assessed during overground walking using motion capture analysis

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Joint Powers During Walking
secondaryOutcomes.description: Joint powers (W/kg) of the hip, knee, and ankle during walking assessed using force platform analysis.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of Parkinson's disease
* Hoehn \& Yahr stages 1-3
* Stable antiparkinsonian medication for at least 4 weeks
* Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) score ≥ 18
* Ability to walk independently (with or without assistive device)
* Medical clearance for participation in moderate-intensity exercise

Exclusion Criteria:

* Change in medication
* Contraindication to exercise

ipdSharingStatementModule.description: Anonymized datasets will be avaliable after the completion of the study and publication of main results
